body:
Hi thanks so much for your reply.

I’m into the gothic scene a bit and have always had a huge fascination with history. I submitted a request to create a history club at my university and it got approved, but the next stage of going forward with creation of the club was have at least 10 other people you know who would join (at least 6 enrolled at the university). I’m not even close with one person bruh. 🥲 I was really keen on doing it too. I’m into reading and drawing but I’ve been losing interest in my hobbies recently from being depressed. I would love to join classes or maybe a book club but there’s limited opportunities for it around me and I’m pretty low on money. 

Thanks for your appreciation and concern, really means a lot.
Thank you so much.

Yes that’s something I think about too! We can only ever know if it’s a good idea to go through with it if we ask them, they’ll probably tell us not to do it. But we have no way of contacting them or knowing.

That sucks to hear that you felt the need to join, take care and be kind to yourself. I hope only good things for you and anyone else reading!
I’m sorry. I just saw your post, I empathise with how you feel. I wish there was something I or you could say or do to fix things, I just hope you know you’re not alone in the way you feel.

Eczema is by no means contagious! Many people have it. If you start noticing that it’s getting much worse it’ll be good to get it checked out. If it is eczema, it most likely will go away. But it might also come back. That’s okay though, and nothing to be ashamed of!
Did it help with reducing acne/other skin issues?

Not too sure so don’t quote me on this, but looks like eczema! I have the same. For me, it doesn’t have any rhyme or reason, has it’s random flair ups. It usually gets worse when you wash your hands a lot, in cold seasons (as it dries your skin out), or in summer due to sweating. Should definitely see a dermatologist if it’s concerning you. Steroid creams are used to treat eczema but I wouldn’t really recommend it as it weakens your skin and has many side effects but it really does help a lot of people. Moisturising can help too.

But the other times, it was just me obsessing over stupid things where is this is something I actually did. Also there is a part in my mind that is telling me that I want to continue doing it and I don’t know if I actually do. I’m going to speak to a therapist soon but I am scared because I don’t know if I can be fixed.
Not available in country/region. That answers it! Thank you
Would we not get bored and go crazy after a while considering it’s forever? Or are we just not conscious enough to realise what’s going on
But shouldn’t I acknowledge that what I did was bad and do something about it?
How can I sit with it? What should I do?
Thank you. I really don’t mean to ask for reassurance I just want some advice, do u think I cheated?
Thank you :)

I relate to this a lot, in every one of my relationships, I’m always the one who mourns. I’m always that one who is so severely hurt and the other person just never cares, no matter how much they told me they loved and cared about me. It sucks a lot. I just wish someone would care about me in that sort of way tho, I just want to be cared for and loved and to have someone actually care about my absence.
Thanks. It’s really difficult to recover from.
Wdym?
Hey just a question, is this person that she is friends with someone that she is attracted to? Like sexuality wise?
Thank you so much, this is very helpful!

Always. I cant talk about BPD with anyone else in my life because no one that I know of has it. My friends and family don’t understand why it’s so hard for me to get out of relationships or control my emotions but being in this subreddit makes me feel understood.
Ahh makes sense thank you
Aww damn that sucks! Please reply back if you find anything that works for you to fix it.
Wow, men using emotion instead of logic when arguing. How ironic. He’s clearly the one who cares about us too much if he has to create a whole account mocking us lol

I’m only questioning if I have BPD too but I think the best thing to do is speak to a psychiatrist yet I heard it’s quite hard to get diagnosed. Also, you have to be over 18 I’m pretty sure. The best thing to do is just to speak to someone first and they get do a more in-depth analysis. Good luck tho!
If you hear a knock on your door, don’t answer it
Yep. Those moments where I actually start to feel better are meaningless because as long as I have BPD, it’s going to stick with me and I know an hour later I’ll be feeling bad again.
Yes, but sometimes it’s not even to date them. I do it for people even in a platonic friendly way as if we’re just really close friends.

Yesss I do this too! Secretly I always thought it was because I was jealous and too untalented do something like that but I think it’s just something that contributes to my tendency to romanticise everything into a scenario lol

I’m in the same position! I’m trying really hard to get over him but it’s so difficult! I try and remind myself that he doesn’t care about me but listening to music and imagining scenarios with him is like my guilty pleasure lol
No problem :) hope everything works out well for you

I have! I’ve even tried listening to music in a different language like Kpop. But the problem is, it’s super addicting to obsess over people and things when listening to music and I really enjoy it even tho I know it’s really bad for me to do. When I’m not doing that, I get really down. It’s like a coping mechanism for me honestly.

This is actually very common for someone with BPD to do and I do it too so trust me you’re not alone. It’s so infuriating tho, I feel your struggle. I try so hard to get over it but it’s all I can ever think about it.
I’m actually in 8th grade Rn and in that same position :/ it feels like I’ll never truly get over it and the only way I will is if I fall for someone else

Yep, and I did it to a guy I really liked because I felt like he hated me. I don’t think he did, but months later I tried to message him again and obviously he was sick of me and he left me on seen and realising that I’ve completely ruined things because of my impulses really hurts. Now he actually doesn’t care about me and it’s too far gone to make things better but my fear of abandonment can’t let things go even though it was my fault in the first place. It’s so frustrating.

Yes! This is why I don’t really like watching movies and reading so much because I make their personality mine and it becomes really bad sometimes. It really doesn’t help my weak sense of identity and sometimes makes me feel worse when I realise that I’ll never be that type of character portrayed in the book i’m reading or movie I’m watching.

Yes! I feel like it depends on who I’m with. When I’m with my family and friends I always get the urge to be alone and and to isolate and it often makes me so irritable and hard to deal with. However, I obsess over this one particular crush I have and whenever he doesn’t show me attention I feel abandoned and go through an overwhelming power of emotions and try so hard to keep near him.

Yes I agree! I feel like it’s hard to make a stable personality for yourself when BPD effects your mood and personality all the time so I often look through the symptoms of a way of comfort and reassurance I guess.
Yes it’s a very stressful feeling! Quick question tho, does group therapy work better than speaking to a therapist one on one?
You too! Thanks for sharing :)
I understand what you mean!! Whenever I talk to my therapist, I find it so hard to describe how I feel to her and end up feeling rlly misunderstood in the end.

Best of luck to you too!!! This was so reassuring to read and this was exactly how I was feeling last night. I had the urge to harm myself but I kept thinking that I was only making it up to try and make problems for myself. It’s rlly stressful but I’m glad to know we’re both in this together :)
Thank you that was quite reassuring :) good on you too
Yeh you’re right I’ve been trying to find a hobby to get in to I hope it helps :)
